items.title: Carmen Lundy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 15, 2023
items.q: And he was my teacher. So he became my teacher.

ctx.x: Did the classical music voice teachers ever say to you, “I don’t like what I’m hearing, where is this coming from? Are you doing jazz? Or were you blessed with open-minded profs? © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-

Yes. Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes. Mary Henderson Buckley was my first voice teacher at the University of Miami and Mary Henderson Buckley flat out, straight up, classical voice. Okay? And I studied with her for my first two and a half years, or something like that. We’re talking a while ago. And something interesting occurred. And the cool thing about Mary Henderson Buckley was she knew that I was kind of floating back and forth and there’s something called a jury where every Friday at noon classical vocalists, you…

That’s terrific because the jazz education was not established like it is now, so the fact that you had that positive experience is very nice to hear. I wonder if you ever brought an original song to your lessons at that time?
